files.authorship: AoE2RMSIDE project owner; supplied and accepted on 2026-11-10 as original art for the generated map icon's relics (the owner states it contains no game content).
files.transformation: Copied from the supplied 1254 x 1254 RGBA PNG (sha256 fc3a4f041f7fc5ddbfff4656b4c0fc65cb2da3bb9545cb219160952a472ab09e3) with only its embedded caBX metadata chunk removed; the IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks, and so every pixel, are byte-for-byte as supplied. A white marble pedestal with a golden flame statue and a thick dark outline on a transparent background, drawn for every relic. Bundled with the desktop renderer and processed at run time into the generated map icon's relics and monuments layer: an alpha levels step (alpha 8 or less becomes transparent, 248 or more opaque, linear in between) that removes faint specks and makes the nearly opaque body fully opaque, a crop to the visible pixels, and an area-average downscale over premultiplied colors to the chosen size.

Bundled with the desktop renderer and processed at run time into the generated map icon's relics and monuments layer: an alpha levels step (alpha 8 or less becomes transparent, 248 or more opaque, linear in between) that removes faint specks and makes the nearly opaque body fully opaque, a crop to the visible pixels, and an area-average downscale over premultiplied colors to the chosen size.
